book.name: IBELIU
book.title: ME IBELIU ꞌIDI LETA YESU MANUNA

content: ꞌIna onaupaupa manuda ꞌetamo ꞌimiyami, ꞌaene ꞌina eyawaiꞌata tauna ꞌenega tada loba, ꞌenega ꞌilobweneda be tamatauta ꞌabona nai ꞌaimi wabebeꞌu be geyaꞌabo walobaloba.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tetela nina ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeda, taudi wate lowaenei ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ta tetela nina nigeya ꞌilemelemedi, manuna sinononaya ta nigeya siemiemise.

Ta ꞌaboꞌada ꞌana toemisao talobena, ta taudi lowaenei geyaꞌabo silobaloba, manuna Yaubada ꞌiona upaupaedi, ꞌigwae, “Yagamwasowaledi, ꞌenega yabaꞌedi be geyaꞌabo ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌeguyega silobaloba.” Yaubada ꞌina eyawaiꞌata nina ꞌimiyami, manuna tuta nina baleꞌu maiboꞌana ꞌimweluluina ga ꞌigumwalaya, ta ꞌenega ꞌieyawaiꞌata.
Ta ꞌasiyata nina ꞌieyawaiꞌataya manuna niꞌatu Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌisimanena, ꞌigwae, “Yaubada ꞌasiyata esebenina ꞌena ꞌina paisewa maiboꞌana ꞌenega ꞌieyawaiꞌata.”
ꞌEnega tanuwanuwa ona gete manuna, “Geyaꞌabo ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌeguyega silobaloba.”
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata nina ꞌimiyami be ꞌaidi namo siloba, ta taudi tetela sigimi nonona ta loina sisinalinaya geyaꞌabo silobaloba.

ꞌEnega Yaubada tuta auwauna ꞌisaꞌuna be ꞌena tomota ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata siloba, ta ꞌenega mwalatoi Debida ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena ga Debida nina ꞌigwae, “Batuwa, ꞌabo Yaubada ꞌenana wanono geyaꞌabo saꞌi wadebadeba paꞌala.”

Ta ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata nina Yaubada ꞌionaenaya nigeya Yosuwa ma ꞌana bodao ꞌidi ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata manuna, ta mali ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata manuna, tuta ꞌebweu auwauna ꞌisaꞌuna be ꞌaene tomota ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata nina sida loba.
ꞌEnega Yaubada ꞌina tomota ꞌaboꞌada ꞌida ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌimiyami, ta ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata nina Sabate ꞌana eyawaiꞌata nadigega.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma talobai, tauda ꞌida paisewega taeyawaiꞌata, nadigega Yaubada lowa ꞌina paisewega ꞌieyawaiꞌataꞌesa.
Ta ꞌilobweneda be tatoo waiwai be ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata nina taloba, ta geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu yaita ꞌilooguitoyasa, ꞌabona nai ꞌibebeꞌu, nadigega taudi lowaenei sibeꞌuꞌesa.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yaubada ꞌina ona mayawasina ta waiwaina ꞌatuwa sisisaiya ꞌina mamatana sena luwaluwana, ta sawesawenaya ꞌibadida be solaꞌaiꞌailidaya nuwanuwa be bubuna kwaikwaiyidi simiyami.
Manuna Yaubada matanaya nigeya ꞌebweu wate yage ꞌida miya kwaiya, maiboꞌadi siloꞌatamanedi, ta tauna ꞌena maꞌetamo ꞌida guinuwa maiboꞌana tasimanedi.
ꞌIda totaliya sinabwana ta boboꞌana ꞌimiyami, tauna Yesu, Yaubada Natuna, niꞌatu manuda ꞌituꞌe galewaya, ꞌenega ꞌida emisa ꞌenaya tagiyaiꞌiꞌisi.

ꞌAidi totaliyao nigeya siꞌateꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyeda ꞌida nenetao manudi, ta Yesu esi ꞌida miyamwau ꞌinuwa sabwalenidi ta ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyeda, manuna lowa baleꞌuya Seitani ꞌina ꞌebetoo maiboꞌana ꞌilobedi nadigega ꞌaboꞌada talobaloba ꞌesedi, ta Yesu nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌiloeloegesi.
ꞌEnega ma ida ꞌatepatu talalaga be tasidasida ꞌada Toloina nina ꞌena, be ꞌenega ꞌida miyamwau ꞌediya ꞌida ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyeda, be wate ꞌilemeda.
